run_mine_bitext: run the CLI tool to mine parallel bitext pairs from source and target language embedding directories
run_knnGPU_sharded: run GPU-accelerated sharded k-nearest-neighbor search on batches of sentence embeddings using FAISS
run_score_candidates: run scoring on candidate bitext pairs using forward and backward mean similarity with a margin function
run_load_batch: run loading and L2-normalizing sentence embeddings from a binary file given the embedding dimension
run_get_batches: run discovery of embedding and sentence text batch files in a directory for a given language
